tool.name: ampvis2 frequency plot
tool.description: Generates a barplot with frequency vs read abundance using ampvis2
tool.help:
# ampvis2 frequency plot
Generates a barplot showing frequency vs read abundance using the ampvis2 package.
## Input
- **Ampvis2 RDS dataset**: An RDS file generated by ampvis2 tools (e.g., ampvis2: load, mergereplicates, or subset sample). - **Metadata list**: A metadata list file generated by ampvis2 tools, used for selecting metadata variables.
## Output
- **Output format**: Choose between HTML, PNG, or PDF for the plot format.
## Documentation
For more details, visit the [ampvis2 documentation](https://kasperskytte.github.io/ampvis2/reference/amp_frequency.html).
